nom: ANUA PDRN Collagen Melting Patch For Neck

avis.titre: Skincare Staple
avis.texte: I will say one of the best products I have used. It is a little confusing/ difficult the first time to apply but once you do it then you’ve got it down for next time. When I put on the patches, spray myself down and let it sit for a minutes then when pulling the white patches off it leaves a clear almost film like smooth texture. I very gently pat and smooth it around my entire face and forehead and let it dry. One thing to note, it is a little drying, so after I added hydrating moisturizer and the next day my face is INSTANTLY smooth (I have combination skin). I fell for the ad and this product will definitely be a staple in my skin care routine. The kit comes with full size spray, 4x neck patches, and 4x use for face patches (left and right side), all come individually wrapped. Rating- 9/10 but completely worth it.

avis.titre: These neck patches were a pleasant surprise. I love them.
avis.texte: I was really curious about these, and they’re actually a fun, targeted treatment—especially for areas where you want a little extra smoothing or hydration. They melt into the skin as you wear them, which feels different from traditional patches. I used them in areas where I want a little plumping effect, and my skin did look smoother afterward. What stood out to me: Unique “melting” technology Leaves skin feeling hydrated and smoother Great for targeted areas Easy to use What to know: Results are temporary (like most patches) More of a treatment boost than a daily essential Great for: Special occasions, targeted anti-aging care, or boosting hydration A great add-on treatment when you want your skin to look a little extra glowy.

avis.titre: I wasted my moneyI wasted my money
avis.texte: The neck patches do not have any collagen on them, they did not stick to my skin. The are dry even when “misted” them, I did not see a difference. Poor advertising of this product. I very disappointed.

avis.titre: Be sure to read instructions and watch videos to learn how to use it properlyBe sure to read instructions and watch vide
avis.texte: Pros: I decided to try the ANUA PDRN Collagen Melting Patch after seeing it all over my social media feed during Prime Day, and the melting effect really is fun to watch in person. Once I sprayed my neck with the ANUA PDRN Mist first, the pink film disappeared into a clear layer almost instantly, and after a second spray to loosen the white top layer, my neck was left with that thin, barely there residue everyone talks about in the videos. The ANUA patches felt gentle going on and the whole process, once I understood the two spray steps, was quick and easy to fit into an evening routine. I followed up with a heavier cream afterward and my skin felt soft and hydrated for the rest of the night. As an occasional treat for my neck, this was a satisfying little skincare ritual and I can see why it has gotten so much attention online. Cons: My biggest hesitation with the ANUA PDRN Collagen Melting Patch is the price relative to what you get, since a box only includes four patches and that is not something I could work into a daily habit at full price. The application process is also easy to get wrong if you have not watched a demo first, since the instructions do not make it obvious that you need to spray twice, once to melt the pink layer and again to loosen the white layer underneath, and I noticed several other reviewers ran into the same confusion. avis.titre: I'll actually use these on my forehead sometimes :
avis.texte: I have been using all of ANUA's PDRN line for the past couple months. I have been getting compliments from people left and right. Even had a co-worker I hadn't seen in a couple weeks walking into my office and they demanded to know why and how I looked younger. My skin is smooth and soft. It has a glow to it that it never had before. The results aren't immediate but worth the wait.

avis.titre: Just OK
avis.texte: These are just ok. They do make the skin smooth but have a strange application. You have to get the patch wet then peel off the mesh outer layer. It then essentially disintegrates onto your neck. Won’t buy again as it doesn’t do anything that lotion can’t.

avis.titre: East of money, do not recommend!
avis.texte: Absolutely useless… would give Zero stars if it was an option. They do nothing. Can’t even tell if there was product on the paper thin “patch”, once you wet it nothing happens. Wouldn’t not recommend purchasing this product.

avis.titre: Cool to use but not worth the price (yet)
avis.texte: Really like the product, it does work but for the price I do not think I will buy it again unless they go on sale. I use this before I use the Anua collagen and retinol Gua sha product. Make sure to read the directions because you have to peel off the pick film and then put it on your skin.

avis.titre: Poor quality
avis.texte: I was a bit disappointed with these Aqua Collagen patches. The serum wasn't distributed evenly across the patches, leaving some areas almost dry. They also didn't stick to my skin very well. On top of that, due to the recent EU import regulations, I had to pay an additional €3 in import charges for each patch, which made them extremely expensive. Considering the quality and the extra cost, they simply aren't worth the money. I wouldn't purchase them again. 😕

avis.titre: Parches de colageno para el cuello
avis.texte: ¡Estoy obsesionada con estos parches de colágeno para el cuello de Anua! 💖 Desde la primera vez que los usé, noté mi piel mucho más hidratada, suave y con un efecto lifting súper bonito. Me encanta que el parche literalmente se “derrite” en la piel, así que sientes que el colágeno se absorbe completamente sin dejar sensación pegajosa. Además, se ajusta perfecto al cuello y cubre toda la zona, ayudando a suavizar las líneas y arruguitas. Después de usarlos, mi cuello se ve más firme, luminoso y con una apariencia más joven. Es como un tratamiento de spa en casa 😍 Definitivamente los recomiendo 100%, son ideales si quieres hidratar, reafirmar y darle glow a esta zona que muchas veces olvidamos. ✨

avis.titre: Neck care, smooth skin
avis.texte: It’s incredibly convenient because you can just apply it to your neck before bed and leave it on overnight. No need to remove it. I often forget to take care of my neck since it feels like an extra step, but with this patch, I just peel off the mesh layer and go to sleep, which makes it easy to use every day. When I wake up in the morning, my neck feels noticeably smoother and softer.

avis.titre: Weird sticky feeling that does not go away
avis.texte: This review is for ANUA PDRN Collagen Melting Patch for Neck, which is made in Korea. These are neck patches that contain PDRN, which is supposed to be moisturizing, along with collagen which is good for wrinkles. The patches have a base side that you remove and you are supposed to apply them to a damp neck for better adhesion and melting. You are also supposed to spray the other side with a mist but there is no mist included so you have to use your own. I think this should be better articulated or they should include a small mist sample. You can use water as any liquid will cause the patch to melt. Now the weird part. The patch is seemingly some powder that dissolves when wet but it is STICKY. I applied it with my neck stretched up but when I relaxed I could feel my skin sticking to itself. I allowed it to fully dry for about 5 minutes then applied a moisturizer on top. This normally works with other sticky products to cut down on the sticky feeling but not this time. The weird sticky feeling reminded me the patch was on any time I moved my neck. I could not see it but I could certainly feel it and I have sensory issues so this was not comfortable at all. I went to bed and woke up the next morning and my neck was still sticky. I love the Anua brand but this is a nope for me. No matter what moisturizer I applied o top the sticky feeling just would not go away. avis.titre: Easy application
avis.texte: I’ve been a little self-conscious about the lines on my neck, so I wanted to try this out. It feels hydrating and not sticky, which I really like. I haven’t used it long enough to see big results yet, but overall it seems like a solid product so far.

avis.titre: Cooling and soothing
avis.texte: The patch adheres smoothly without irritation, and the cooling gel texture feels soothing on the skin.

avis.titre: Slightly stings
avis.texte: I like the concept of this collagen melting patch but it didn't really do anything for me. My skin type: Sensitive I used rose water for the application process and it made the mask slightly stick to my skin. I sprayed about 5 mists before AND after. I feel like the mask itself doesn't have enough give. I had to hold my neck a certain way for it to stay. Perhaps it works better with the Anua spray (which I don't have). My skin was left with a stinging sensation when the mask was applied & afterwards. I'd like to think it's the product 'working' but this doesn't feel right. Do with this information what you will.

avis.titre: Read The Instructions
avis.texte: So I thought this was a sheet mask for my neck. And I believe others who wrote a negative review thought that as well. There was definitely some confusion on my part but the directions are actually pretty clear. But since I was coming from the assumption it was a sheet mask for my neck it didn’t register that you take it off immediately. It isn’t meant to stick on your neck. There is a video if you scroll through the images. You place the mesh on your neck. When handling the mesh avoid touching the center. Apply to your neck and spray Anua PDRN spray. And then you take off the mesh and there’s a film that melts into your neck. Then apply moisturizer over it. It’s a 30 second process.

avis.titre: Poor Quality – Patch Missing Product in Several Areas
avis.texte: I’m very disappointed with this product. The beauty patch was not consistent, parts of it had product, but several areas were completely empty, with nothing on them. It looked defective and uneven. Because of this, I’d like to return the product and request a refund.

avis.titre: Cheap garbage
avis.texte: Crap! Small patches only cover a small section of the neck. The Anua PDRN + Hyaluron it came with smells horrible, like vinegar. Does not leave a glassy look or glow at all this is garbage. Buyer beware. I hope I can return it. It’s not cheap & a total waste of money .

avis.titre: DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THESE PATCHES
avis.texte: Patches are NOT together and would not stick to my face.. reached out to the company sent him pictures and they told me they couldn’t help me. I had to reach out to Amazon. Amazon tells you to reach out to the company for product support.. would not order them again ever.

avis.titre: Good product, but pricey
avis.texte: I just finished the last of the four patches. At first, I thought they would be the same as regular sheet masks, so I was a bit confused. I had to read the instructions carefully. You need to remove the pink backing sheet and apply the white sheet to your neck. After that, I sprayed a facial mist over it, and it immediately dissolved into my skin. Then you can remove the mesh sheet from your neck. It’s a new method, but you get used to it quickly. Just be careful not to touch the sheet with wet hands like I did. Since it’s made of pure collagen, it melts right away when it touches moisture, even on your fingers. It seems like a good product with great ingredients. However, four patches aren’t enough to see noticeable results. To be honest, I couldn’t really tell if it made a difference on my skin. I just wish it came with more patches or was a bit more affordable.

avis.titre: Collagen And PDRN Does Melt Into Skin
avis.texte: This is one of the strangest products that I have used. I expected a creamy mask, but instead got a mostly dry thin mesh. You pull out an opaque mesh from the package (see my photo), and after applying you end up with a mesh that is now see through (see my photo) as the ingredients that were in the mesh are now on your neck. Now for the details on how to apply this neck patch: you need to start with a clean neck, and I did apply toner at first. After this make sure you have dry hands, and carefully remove the pink cover from the patch. The instructions did say you can apply to moisturized skin, but my toner has a slight touch of oil to it, so I didn't moisturize first. The side against the pink cover is where the ingredients are (and you can see that one side is more coated with stuff than the other), so it's this side you want to put against your neck. It's dry but slightly sticky so when I put them on my neck they do stay in place long enough for me to spray it with water to get the ingredients to melt onto my skin. It's unclear to me what you are supposed to spray this with. I used water because I had nothing else, but they show their Hydra-Glow Capsule Mist infused with PDRN (Salmon DNA) and Hyaluronic Acid that may boost effectiveness. I don't know, because I did not have that. But they did say it melts on contact with moisture so I figured a mist of water would work. avis.titre: The Magic Trick Patch That Leaves Nothing Behind (Must Read Directions!)
avis.texte: This was a really intriguing product to try because I’ve never used a collagen melting patch for the neck before, or any melting patch for that matter. As someone with aging, oilier skin that can be sensitive at times, I'm always looking for targeted treatments that can firm and hydrate without causing congestion or irritation. This ANUA patch is a unique experience, but it has a learning curve, so reading the directions is essential to ensure you get the benefit! Scent (5/5): Since this is essentially a film of high-purity collagen and PDRN, there is virtually no scent. It's completely non-intrusive and ideal for sensitive skin and those who are fragrance-averse. Texture & Feel (4/5): The patch itself is an incredibly thin, film-like material on a mesh backing. Once the mesh is removed and the collagen has melted, the area might feel sticky at first while it's drying down. I apply my neck cream immediately afterward. It eventually gets less sticky as hours go by, but I can't promise it becomes completely non-tacky. It is not heavy or occlusive, which is wonderful for my neck area, especially since I run warm. Application & Fit (4/5): This is the most crucial part, so here are the best steps for success. First, you must ensure your hands are dry to prevent the patch from melting prematurely. avis.titre: Unique experience, not sure of efficacy or cost
avis.texte: This was a unique product with a melting patch application. The instructions are really clear and it felt sort of akin to applying a temporary tattoo. The collagen melts right into the skin! Love that it has no added fragrance/scent . It absorbs well and doesn't leave any sticky residue, in fact, it feels like nothing really is on your skin! I applied it, patted it in and the applied a cream over it. I included a photo of the patch after spritzing it post application and before removing the last mesh layer. I didn't notice much of a chance after use, but like any skin care, it takes time to see results and consistent use. For almost $5 a patch, I'm not sure the value is there. It doesn't cover all the lines on my neck so I would need to use two per use and used regularly, they would really add up. I'm better off spending the cash on some pricey neck tightening anti wrinkle cream like Strivectin. Topical collagen and PDRN has varied opinions about their efficacy due to the large size of their molecules which have a hard time penetrating skin. At worst it's hydrating, at best it may help a little with elasticity but it's not going to erase wrinkles over night. But your mileage may vary so it's worth a try!

avis.titre: May have to use more often to get effectiveness
avis.texte: This is my first time using collagen like this. I did find that it layered on my skin as intended, and it was not sticky. It’s a different kind of application. I didn’t feel like it firmed my skin whatsoever and I think that the pads are so small for the surface that you want to put them on- your neck. More applications might be needed to get this outcome. I am in my mid 50s and I do have sun damage on the areas I used it on. The value is definitely good and it does not have a scent. It wasn't too difficult to use, but as you can see in one of my pictures that I accidentally touched the side of the collagen and got it all over my fingers. I’m not sure that it is effective, but I’ll probably need more applications.

avis.titre: Irritated my skin
avis.texte: I had a hard time keeping it in place. Its did irritate my skin. Not sure if that's just a me thing or not. I do not have sensitive skin normally.

avis.titre: great after-feel, confusing application
avis.texte: i was torn on this at first. application is confusing and takes trial and error the patch didn’t stay put easily. i used a hypochlorous acid spray to mist my neck to get it to adhere and melt properly. during use, it felt awkward and not very user-friendly. that said, i have very sensitive skin and this caused zero irritation. once it fully melted, my neck felt noticeably smooth and silky, like really soft. this is clearly a collagen film that melts into a hydrating, smoothing layer, not a long-term treatment. the results are immediate and cosmetic (plumping/softening), not firming or lifting over time. between the learning curve and the price (about $5 per patch), i wouldn’t use this regularly — but the after-feel earned it an extra star. nice for occasional neck smoothing, just not a must-have.
